details:
A new system that allows stuff to attach to other people or world.

Magnets are able to attract to or repel from other magnets within the radius and the force increase the closer it comes. 

Magnet component options:

Magnetic pole (positive or negative)

Magnetic Strength

Radius

Tag (pole option to positive or negative)

Colliders (pole option to positive or negative)

(bool) Locked  animateable -> allows to stick to the same magnet and move.

Animator Parameters:

bool isAttached 

bool Magnetic_Force (the strength of the force of the 2 magnets -> this also be -1, if 2 of same poles get close)

bool Magnetic_Distance (distance from other magnet)

Magnets can be attracted to any other magnet or by the default colliders like hand, fingers and head.

Since Magnets won't move on themself towards other magnets maybe add them to physics bones or addon for physicsbones that bones get deformed if there is a magnet on any of children

But having a way to attract object from other avatar or connect them and do animation stuff because of it.

It can be used for to make props that can stay on other people avatar. Or drop them in the world. 

There so many more possibilities with interacting with world and other avatars.
title: [Feature Request] Avatar Magnetic Component
